maudhui: (1) The United Republic is a democratic, secular and socialist state which adheres to multi-party democracy. (2) All matters pertaining to the registration and administration of political parties in the United Republic shall be governed by the provisions of this Constitution and of a law enacted by Parliament for that purpose.
